svg.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: The Real Part and One Bit · Figure 7 · Step 10 · The Bit Delivered Twice
svg.text: FIGURE 7
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE
RH: THE REAL PART AND ONE BIT · MASTER v3.0.39_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE UNICORN IMPASSE
THE IMPASSE
Given the real part at T, RH is exactly the unicorn part at T. No registered point
lies off the line, and above every height no reading of an even record decides it:
the only door is the bit.

svg.text: THE DICHOTOMY
The record recurses on itself at every configuration and one record covers two
worlds, so the bit closes only by an act that reads past the record.

tspan.font-family: RHMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: STAGE 1 · LOCAL COMPUTATION · THE FORMAL KIND
THE CARGO LOOP
B′ holds, verifies itself, and absorbs every premise; the loop stops at the record,
and the step to the zeros is the bridge.

svg.text: THE ACT
A reflection-closed configuration with least erasure at it; the canonical bundle at
the record exists for every configuration, and at the zeros the bundle is the bit.

svg.text: THE BRIDGE GIVES RH, THREE WAYS
By the normal form applied, by self-recognition enforcing the bridge, and by the
terminal capstone, nothing before its colon.

svg.text: THE FORMAL KIND DELIVERS
On the chart the cargo carried from the record closes the value, on no axiom.

tspan.font-family: RHMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE COMPUTATION, WITNESSED
The kernel checks every step; the sealed volume runs finite instances of the
closure a second time in Fortran, 13,081 checks with zero failures; the closure
over infinite zero sets is checked by the kernel alone.
STAGE 2 · EXTERNAL PHYSICS · THE GRAND WITNESS
THE EIGHT PRINTED PREMISES, IN THE KERNEL'S UNITS
1 · the chart reading carries LookBack to ζ
2 · the vacuum realizes the carrier of every read zero
3 · a charged carrier is a population ≥ n₀
4 · it annihilates at a rate ≥ r₀
5 · the temperature is ≥ T₀
6 · the residual covers population × rate × heat
7 · a certified bound R ≤ ε on a dataset
8 · the gap: ε < δ = n₀·r₀·T₀·693147
THE CARRIER CLOSES THE UNICORN
On the act's zero set the unicorn part is closed at every height; on the actual
zeros the reading gives the line and the refuter's absence.

svg.text: LOOKBACK AND RH IN ONE THEOREM
From the eight printed premises, through the carrier closure on the chart,
pointwise and on no axiom.

svg.text: THE GRAND WITNESS ERADICATES
Its premises cannot all stand on a world carrying an off-line pair; the physical
kind delivers the value on no axiom.

svg.text: ONE BIT, DELIVERED TWICE · EACH STEP FROM IT A THEOREM
TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
On the chart every witness of the value, from any
premise, is a witness of both kinds, the formal
cargo and the physical carrier; over ℂ every proof
of RH yields the formal kind at the zeros, the bridge
itself.

svg.text: THE FORCED FORM OF EVERY PROOF
Every proof of the value constructs the act; any two
proofs are one; the form of the field of the value is
the form of every proof of the hypothesis.

svg.text: THE SAME BIT, AS A FIELD
The conservation field, the chiral defect vanishing
at every zero, gives RH in one term through the
made-zero seat.
